series.name: Office / Productivity
series.title: Office Flow — 1 Hour Lofi for Work & Productivity | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A focused 1-hour Peter Lofi session designed for productive work, planning, reading and everyday office routines. Warm keys, restrained drums and a steady unobtrusive groove keep momentum without demanding attention.

series.name: Late Night Office
series.title: Late Night Office — 1 Hour Lofi for After Hours Focus | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: One hour of darker, calmer Peter Lofi for late deadlines, quiet offices and after-hours concentration. Soft keys, deep bass and restrained nocturnal textures create a focused city-at-night atmosphere.

series.name: Coffee Shop
series.title: Coffee Shop Lofi — 1 Hour Cozy Beats for Work & Study | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A cozy 1-hour coffee-shop session for studying, journaling, writing and relaxed work. Warm electric piano, mellow drums and soft bass create the feeling of a calm city café without distracting ambience or vocals.

series.name: Rooftop Office
series.title: Rooftop Office — 1 Hour Skyline Lofi & Chill Beats | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A one-hour skyline session with airy synths, clean drums and an uplifting urban pulse. Built for creative work, design sessions and focused evenings above the city.

series.name: Rainy Office
series.title: Rainy Office — 1 Hour Cozy Lofi for Deep Work | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A calm rainy-day work session with soft piano-like keys, muted percussion and spacious pads. One hour built for deep reading, writing and concentration while the city slows down outside.

series.name: Sunday Morning Work
series.title: Sunday Morning Work — 1 Hour Soft Lofi & Easy Focus | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: Bright, gentle and unhurried. This one-hour Peter Lofi session is made for quiet Sunday planning, light work, reading and a slow start with warm melodic textures and relaxed rhythm.

series.name: Deep Focus / Coding
series.title: Deep Focus Coding — 1 Hour Minimal Lofi for Flow State | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A minimal one-hour coding soundtrack engineered for long focus blocks. Repetitive but evolving motifs, controlled low end and precise restrained drums help maintain flow without pulling attention away from the screen.

series.name: Luxury Office / Zara-style ambience
series.title: Luxury Office — 1 Hour Fashion Lounge & Deep Focus | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A polished luxury-office session inspired by premium fashion-retail ambience: clean deep-house pulse, elegant synth textures and refined lounge energy for work, showrooms, studios and sophisticated background listening.

series.name: Work From Home
series.title: Work From Home — 1 Hour Cozy Lofi for Productivity | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A comfortable one-hour home-office mix for emails, meetings, planning and everyday productivity. Warm keys, soft beats and relaxed textures keep the room calm while helping the workday move forward.

series.name: Night Shift
series.title: Night Shift — 1 Hour Dark Lofi for Late Work & Focus | Peter Lofi 🎧
series.description: A darker one-hour Peter Lofi set for overnight work, editing, coding and long late sessions. Deep bass, restrained drums and subtle neon synth textures create momentum without breaking concentration.

series.name: Gaming Focus
series.title: 3 Hours Gaming Lofi 🎮 Beats to Play, Focus & Chill | Peter Lofi
series.description: Three hours of original instrumental Peter Lofi music for gaming, focus and long play sessions.
